pt.selectedTitle: Papai Vlad Tentou Acampar no Quintal! #Shorts
pt.description: Papai Vlad tentou montar uma barraca de acampamento no quintal sem ler o manual e causou a maior confusão engraçada com toda a Família Spitz!

titleOptions: Tent Chaos with the Spitz Family!
en.description: Dad Vlad tried pitching a camping tent in the backyard without reading the manual and created total hilarious chaos with the Spitz Family!

text.pt: Hoje a família Spitz decidiu acampar no quintal para uma noite muito divertida.
text.en: Today the Spitz family decided to camp in the backyard for a very fun night.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic cinematic 9:16 vertical portrait of Raven, a fluffy black Pomeranian dog wearing round gold-rimmed glasses, a white pearl necklace, and a colorful floral print blouse. She is standing in a lush green backyard garden looking with an amused skeptical expression at a tangled camping tent.

text.pt: Querido, você tem certeza de que sabe montar essa barraca grande sem olhar o manual?
text.en: Honey, are you sure you can pitch this big tent without looking at the manual?

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic cinematic 9:16 vertical portrait of Vlad, a fluffy cream light golden-white Pomeranian dog wearing thin round gold-rimmed glasses, a blue-and-white vertical striped button-down shirt, and a dark navy blue bow tie with tiny dots. He is proudly holding flexible tent poles in the backyard with a confident big smile.

text.pt: Com certeza, minha linda! Eu sou um grande especialista em acampamentos e aventuras na natureza.
text.en: Of course, my dear! I am a great expert in camping and outdoor wilderness adventures.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic cinematic 9:16 vertical portrait of Theo, a fluffy cream light orange Pomeranian dog wearing rainbow multicolored frame glasses and a blue button-down shirt. He is pointing curiously at a bright yellow camping instruction manual in a sunlit green backyard.

text.pt: Papai, acho que essa vara dobrável deveria ficar por dentro do tecido da barraca.
text.en: Dad, I think this folding pole should actually go inside the tent fabric.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic cinematic 9:16 vertical portrait of Jonny, a small fluffy cream light golden Pomeranian dog with no glasses, wearing a crisp white button-down shirt and a dark bow tie. He is laughing joyously in the backyard as a green pop-up tent folds over playfully.

text.pt: Olha só, a barraca se dobrou todinha e prendeu o papai lá dentro, pessoal!
text.en: Look everyone, the tent completely collapsed and trapped dad inside right now!

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic cinematic 9:16 vertical portrait of Luna, a fluffy black Pomeranian dog wearing round gold-rimmed glasses, a white pearl necklace, and a pink ruffled blouse. She is holding a tablet with tent building guides in a bright sunny backyard garden, smiling warmly.

text.pt: Eu disse que seria melhor ler as instruções antes de começar a montagem, papai.
text.en: I told you it would be better to read the manual before starting assembly, dad.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic cinematic 9:16 vertical portrait of Vlad, a fluffy cream light golden-white Pomeranian dog wearing thin round gold-rimmed glasses, a blue-and-white vertical striped button-down shirt, and a dark navy blue bow tie with tiny dots. He is cozy and asleep wrapped in a colorful sleeping bag inside a half-built camping tent.

text.pt: Pelo menos o colchão de ar ficou bem quentinho para eu tirar uma soneca gostosa.
text.en: At least the air mattress turned out very cozy for me to take a nice nap.

text.pt: E assim a família acabou transformando o acampamento em uma festa super divertida no sofá.
text.en: And that is how the family ended up turning camping into a fun couch party.

en: We are the Funny Spitz Family!
